text: Because every classical field satisfies g2(0) = 1 + Var(I)/mean(I)^2 >= 1, any observation of g2(0) < 1 rules out all classical descriptions of the light.
explanation: True. A variance is non-negative (the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality for light), so classical fields cannot dip below g2(0) = 1; antibunching is therefore a rigorous non-classicality witness.
